translationRepairs: Chancellor Chen Ping memorialized: 'I have respectfully deliberated with Marquis of Jiang Bo, Marquis of Quzhou Shang, Marquis of Yingyin Ying, Marquis of Anguo Ling, and others. The marquises have fortunately received bestowed meal allowances and fief incomes. Your Majesty adds further favor by establishing court positions according to the order of their merits. I request that these rankings be preserved in the Gao Temple.'

Chancellor Chen Ping memorialized: 'I have respectfully deliberated with Bo, Marquis of Jiang; Shang, Marquis of Quzhou; Ying, Marquis of Yingyin; Ling, Marquis of Anguo; and others. The marquises have fortunately received bestowed meal allowances and fief incomes. Your Majesty adds further favor by establishing court positions according to the order of their merits. I request that these rankings be preserved in the Gao Temple.'

Chinese 絳侯臣勃、曲周侯臣商、潁陰侯臣嬰、安國侯臣陵 pairs each fief title with the minister's given name; 'Marquis of Jiang Bo' etc. wrongly fuse the name into the title, while 'Bo, Marquis of Jiang' correctly separates them.

Chancellor Chen Ping said: 'I have respectfully deliberated with Marquis of Jiang Bo, Marquis of Quzhou Shang, Marquis of Yingyin Ying, Marquis of Anguo Ling, and others. The marquises have fortunately received bestowed meal allowances and fief incomes. Your Majesty adds further favor by establishing court positions according to the order of their merits. Your subject requests that they be stored in the Gao Temple.'

Chancellor Chen Ping said: 'I have respectfully deliberated with Bo, Marquis of Jiang; Shang, Marquis of Quzhou; Ying, Marquis of Yingyin; Ling, Marquis of Anguo; and others. The marquises have fortunately received bestowed meal allowances and fief incomes. Your Majesty adds further favor by establishing court positions according to the order of their merits. Your subject requests that they be stored in the Gao Temple.'

Same structure as the idiomatic line: each 侯 title is followed by 臣 plus the given name alone; separating 'Bo, Marquis of Jiang' (and parallel forms) removes the fused-name error without changing sense.
She assisted Emperor Gao in settling the realm; three men among her father, brothers, and associates with the emperor were enfeoffed as marquises.
She assisted Emperor Gao in settling the realm; three men among her father and brothers were enfeoffed as marquises under Emperor Gao.

In 父兄及高祖而侯者三人, 及高祖而侯 means those among her father and brothers who became marquises under Gaozu; the before invents 'associates with the emperor,' and the after matches the Chinese and the already-correct idiomatic reading.
